description.en: A dirt path leading all the way up to a stranded, crumbled village.
description.sc: 泥土路的尽头是一座衰败、而又破碎的村庄。
description.tc: 泥土路的盡頭是一座衰敗、而又破碎的村莊。

description.en: Wind chimes rattle in the wind across the ruined streets, witnessing this slaughter in the name of the Divine.
description.sc: 狼藉的街道上风铃随风作响，见证着这场以神之名的屠杀。
description.tc: 狼藉的街道上風鈴隨風作響，見證著這場以神之名的屠殺。

description.en: The instigators praise the name of the Divine, acting without restraint in broad daylight.
description.sc: 始作俑者正在歌颂着神祇的名讳，在光天化日下肆意妄为。
description.tc: 始作俑者正在歌頌著神祇的名諱，在光天化日下肆意妄為。

description.en: Ravaged by flames and smoke, the former trading hub has lost all of its past splendor.
description.sc: 受到战火与硝烟波及，曾经的贸易重镇早已失去了过往荣光。
description.tc: 受到戰火與硝煙波及，曾經的貿易重鎮早已失去了過往榮光。
